description: This Java source file defines the class AnnotationBasedJsonParsable, responsible for deserializing JSON objects into Java objects of type T using reflection to invoke specified parsing methods.

classes.name: AnnotationBasedJsonParsable
classes.description: A final class implementing JsonParsable<T> that uses reflection to call a static parsing method on a class to deserialize JSON objects.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the API v2 key associated with this parsing strategy.

methods.name: getV1FallbackKey
methods.description: Returns the API v1 fallback key; deprecated in favor of getKey().

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Invokes the specified static parse method on the class to deserialize a JsonObject into an object of type T.

methods.name: buildDittoJsonException
methods.description: Constructs a DittoJsonException with details about the cause of a parsing error.
